title: Cube of Thought
description: Light modpack made for a group of friends (Кубът Мисъл)
body:
This is a light modpack made for a group of friends (Кубът Мисъл) including only the most essential optimization mods along with a handful of visual/audio enhancement mods to make the experience prettier & more fun!

Below is a list of all mods and what they do (for whoever's interested):

<details>
<summary>Optimization</summary>

- [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) - Core optimization mod used. Optimizes rendering, therefore increasing FPS, among many other things (The modern OptiFine).
- [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium) - Game logic optimization.
- [Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling) - Hides entities that aren't visible.
- [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core) - Reduces the memory usage.

</details>


<details>
<summary>Utilities</summary>
  
- [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) - Adds a mod menu to view the list of mods you have installed.
- [Mouse Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/mouse-tweaks) - Makes moving items much faster (allows draging your mouse over slots, instead of having to click each one individually.) Check the mod page for more info!
- [Client Sort](https://modrinth.com/mod/clientsort) - Adds button for quick sorting of inventories.
- [Durability Tooltip](https://modrinth.com/mod/durability-tooltip) - Shows you how much uses are left for tools (without having to use F3+H which shows unecessary details).
- [Enchantment Descriptions](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchantment-descriptions) - Describes what enchantment books do.
- [RightClickHarvest](https://modrinth.com/mod/rightclickharvest) - Allows you to harvest crops with right click (no need to break & replace them!).
- [Veinminer](https://modrinth.com/datapack/veinminer) - Adds the ability to break a clump of blocks (ores, wooden logs) together.
- [Veinminer Enchantment](https://modrinth.com/datapack/veinminer-enchantment) - Makes it so only tools with the Veinminer enchantment can veinmine.
- [Veinminer Hotkey](https://modrinth.com/mod/veinminer-client) - Makes veinmining active only when pressing a button (set to "~").
- [Shulker Box Tooltip](https://modrinth.com/mod/shulkerboxtooltip) - View the contents of shulker boxes from your inventory.
- [Freecam](https://modrinth.com/mod/freecam) - Press F4 to activate a Spectator Mode to observe builds easier or just look around the world.
- [Litematica](https://modrinth.com/mod/litematica) - Allows creation of schematics of builds that can be copied over from world to world.
- [Cut Through](https://modrinth.com/mod/cut-through) - Weapons now slash through grass instead of breaking it.
- [Leaves Be Gone](https://modrinth.com/mod/leaves-be-gone) - Leaves decay instantly so you don't have to wait for them to disappear.
- [NetherPortalFix](https://modrinth.com/mod/netherportalfix) - Ensures correct destinations when travelling back and forth through Nether Portals in Multiplayer.
- [Resourcify](https://modrinth.com/mod/resourcify) - Service for downloading resource packs, data packs & shaders in-game.
- [Datapack Injector](https://modrinth.com/mod/datapack-injector) - Automatically injects datapacks into any world.
- [Default Options](https://modrinth.com/mod/default-options) - Keeps settings (video settings, controls, etc.) saved for modpacks.

</details>


<details>
<summary>Visual Enhancements</summary>

- [Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) - Loads Shaders. 
- [LambDynamicLights](https://modrinth.com/mod/lambdynamiclights) - Holding blocks/items that emit light, they'll illuminate your surroundings.
- [Voxy](https://modrinth.com/mod/voxy) - Allows for infinite chunk rendering (using LODs so it's very performant).
- [Skin Restorer](https://modrinth.com/mod/skinrestorer) - Used for loading player skins.
- [Skin Shuffle](https://modrinth.com/mod/skinshuffle) - For addings skins using local files / switching between skins.
- [Status Effect Bars](https://modrinth.com/mod/status-effect-bars) - Adds timer to the potion effect overlay to track when they'll run out.
- [Better Clouds](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-clouds) - Makes clouds prettier. (especially at sunset)
- [Particle Rain](https://modrinth.com/mod/particle-rain) - Makes rain and snow much prettier, adds surface fog & sandstorms.
- [More Leaf Particles](https://modrinth.com/mod/more-leaf-particles) - Adds more variants to the new falling leaves so all tree types have distinct ones.
- [Xaero's World Map](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map) - Adds a map with many features: mapping explored chunks, making waypoints, tracking where other players are (Press M to view).
- [Xaero's Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap) - Adds the map into the interface (disabled by default).
- [Advancements Reloaded](https://modrinth.com/mod/advancements-reloaded) - Makes the Advancements tab more visually appealing, keeps track of completion goals. (e.g. Tracks all biomes discovered for the advancement Adventuring Time)
- [Euphoria Patches](https://modrinth.com/mod/euphoria-patches) - mod that adds extra settings to Complementary Shaders.

</details>


<details>
<summary>Audio Enhancements</summary>

- [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat) - In-game voice chat for spontaneous discussions even when not in Discord.
- [Voice Chat Interaction](https://modrinth.com/mod/voice-chat-interaction) - Lets talking using Simple Voice Chat get detected by Sculk Sensors.
- [Sound Physics Remastered](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound-physics-remastered) - Adds echo to caves among other cool audio enhancements.
- [Sounds](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound) - Add sounds to inventory interactions & to some in-game actions (swinging a sword, pulling a bow).
- [Cool Rain](https://modrinth.com/mod/coolrain) - Adds ambient sounds for certain blocks during rain.

</details>


<details>
<summary>Resource Packs / Data Packs / Shaders</summary>

- [Authentic Shadows](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/authentic-shadows) - Lowers the resolution of mob shadows to make them fit the Minecraft artstyle better.
- [Even Better Enchants](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/even-better-enchants) - Adds unique textures for all Enchanted Books.
- [Complementary Shaders - Reimagined](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-reimagined) - Great Shaders that remain close to Minecraft's artstyle.

[Vanilla Tweaks](https://vanillatweaks.net/) - Website with small additions to enhance the game. Those include a Resource Pack, Data Pack & Crafting Recipes Data Pack:
**Resource Pack**: has 2 versions -> 
- Main_DarkMode_Cookies (the way I prefer to play, set as the default).
- Main (with some specific additions separated into individual resource packs so you can add/remove whatever you want). 

_Note: if something that bothers you isn't removed in Main, you can open the resource pack on the website and pick & choose whatever features you desire._

**Features exclusive to Main_DarkMode_Cookies (& separated into individual packs for use together with Main):**
- Dark UI - Makes all interfaces Dark Mode
- Numbered Hotbar - Adds small numbers to hotbar slots to make quick switching easier.
- Cookie Hunger Bar - Replaces the default hunger bar with a Cookie icon.

**All other features (included in both versions):**
- Hunger Preview - Adds info to each food item about how much they fill you up.
- Lower Shield - Lowers the height of the shield so it doesn't obscure a quarter of the screen when equipped.
- Brewing Guide - Adds a picture guide showing the ingredients for making all potions.
- HD Shield Banner Patterns - in Vanilla (the game without mods) the banner patterns get compressed in an ugly way when applied to a shield.
- Clearer Wither Hearts - Brightens the texture of hearts for when the players is withered (as they're too dark in Vanilla and hard to distinguish from empty hearts)
- Visual Waxed Copper Items - Makes copper items that have been waxed easier to distinguish in inventories (in Vanilla the only way to tell the difference between waxed and unwaxed is reading their names).
- Ashless Campfires - Removes the ash pile under unlit campfires.
- Plain Leather Armor - Removes features of leather armor that keep the leather color even when the armor is dyed.
- Unique Axolotl Buckets - Axolotl Buckets now depict the correct color of the Axolotl inside (in Vanilla they depict only pink axolotls).
- Visual Honey Stages - Makes Beehives & Bee Nests show how full of honey they are in 5 stages (in Vanilla they have only an empty & full state which don't represent the actual filling process).
- Sticky Piston Sides - Adds a slime texture to the sides of Sticky Pistons so they're easier to distinguish in tight Redstone contraptions.
- Directional Hoppers - Adds arrow to all sides of hoppers to make it clear where they're pointing, again helps in tight contraptions.
- Directional Dispensers & Droppers - Same thing but for Dispensers & Droppers.
- Directional Observers - Same thing.
- Unobtrusive Rain - Reduces the amount of rain particles.
- Unobtrusive Snow - Reduces the amount of snow particles.
- Unique Painting Items - Adds icons to all paintings in the Creative inventory for easy distinction.
- Colored Ping Indicator - Adds more colors to the ping icon when pressing Tab.

**Data Pack**

Teleport-commands:
- back - Go back to where you where, useful after dying.
- home - Teleports you to your home (location must be set first).
- spawn - Teleport to the spawn.
- tpa - Request to be teleported to another player.

Other cool tools:
- Armor statues - Adds a book for tweaking the positioning of Armor Stands (you can now give them arms).
- Silence mobs - Using a name tag renamed to "Silence me" mutes any mob it's applied to.
- Cauldron Mud - Throwing Dirt into a Cauldron filled with water turns it into Mud.
- Cauldron Concrete - Throwing Concrete Powder into a Cauldron filled with water turns it into Concrete.
- Fast Leaf Decay - Does the same thing as the mod Leaves Be Gone, added in case the mod doesn't update quickly to new versions.

**Crafting Recipes Data Pack**
- Straight to Shapeless - Recipes like Bread & Paper are now craftable in a 2x2 crafting grid.
- Universal Dyeing - Allows dyeing already colored blocks (not just white ones)
- Back to Blocks - Make stairs and slabs back into blocks.
- Blackstone Cobblestone - Adds missing recipes for Blackstone to make it equivalent to cobble.
- Craftable Coral Blocks 2x2 - Adds way to craft Coral Blocks from Corals/Coral Fans.
- Dropper to Dispenser - Can add the bow recipe to a Dropper to make it a Dispenser
- Sandstone Dyeing - Allows crafting of Red Sandstone blocks using red dye.

</details>


<details>
<summary>Libraries / APIs</summary>

Note: these mods don't add any features that players interact with, they serve as a shared code base which the mods above use. You can ignore these.

- [Architectury API](https://modrinth.com/mod/architectury-api)
- [Balm](https://modrinth.com/mod/balm)
- [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin)
- [Forge Config API Port](https://modrinth.com/mod/forge-config-api-port)
- [JamLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/jamlib)
- [M.R.U](https://modrinth.com/mod/mru)
- [MaLiLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/malilib)
- [Prickle](https://modrinth.com/mod/prickle)
- [Puzzles Lib](https://modrinth.com/mod/puzzles-lib)
- [Silk](https://modrinth.com/mod/silk)
- [SuperMartijn642's Config Lib](https://modrinth.com/mod/supermartijn642s-config-lib)
- [YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL)](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl)

</details>
